subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support durable, optionally model-visible TUI-local shell output through `!`/`!!` and a hidden operator-admin gateway method?
rationale: The change establishes a new command convention and privileged sensitive-output persistence contract; code repair cannot decide whether that permanent product boundary is desired.

options.title: Repair and adopt
options.body: Fix both blockers, align documentation, resolve conflicts, and require current-head gateway-backed proof before merge.

options.title: Persist history only
options.body: Allow explicit persistence but keep every local-shell result excluded from model context.

options.title: Keep commands local
options.body: Retain the existing ephemeral local-only behavior and decline the new RPC contract.

recommendation.title: Repair and adopt
recommendation.body: Fix both blockers, align documentation, resolve conflicts, and require current-head gateway-backed proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current TUI local-shell and session-key behavior and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for this product/code decision.
